questions.q: What is your typical daily routine?
questions.answer: It's fairly structured on weekdays. I get up around seven, have a quick breakfast, and I'm at work by nine. After work I usually study for a couple of hours, then [[unwind]] before bed. Weekends are far more relaxed.

questions.q: Do you usually get up early?
questions.answer: Yes, on weekdays I'm up by seven. I've found I think much more clearly in the mornings, so I make the most of that quiet, [[uninterrupted]] time. On weekends, though, I happily allow myself a lie-in.

questions.q: Which part of the day do you like most?
questions.answer: The early morning, surprisingly. It's quiet, the day hasn't got hectic yet, and I feel clear-headed. A calm start with a cup of tea genuinely sets a [[productive]] tone for everything that follows.

questions.q: Do you prefer having a routine or variety?
questions.answer: A bit of both, ideally. A steady routine keeps me productive, but I'd get bored without some variety. So I like structure on weekdays and something a little more [[spontaneous]] at the weekend.

questions.q: Has your routine changed much since you were a student?
questions.answer: Quite significantly. At university my days were far more flexible, and I'd often stay up late and sleep in. Now that I work full-time, I've had to become much more [[disciplined]], which has honestly been good for me.
